Pater filio spurio nulla in re succedit, cum is plane
sit incertus. l. si spurius. ff. unde cognati.

Mater vero, licet sit illustris, aliosque naturales & le-

l.i: De successione parentum, ex damnato coitu

main_text.l: Neque pater, neque mater, nec ulli alii ascendentes li-
beris ex damnato coitu susceptis succedere possunt.
Authen. ex complexu. C. de incest. & inutilib. nuptiis.
Sicut filii spirituales non succedunt parentibus
spiritualibus: ita econtra, Parentes spirituales, non
succedunt filiis spiritualibns.

page.notes: The running head is printed in spaced capitals; the u in IURIS is a consonant, so it is written IVRIS. The name at the end of the Schneidewin paragraph is partly worn and was read as Schneidewyn[?]. The printed spelling "spiritualibns" is a printing error and is left as printed. The printed form "filij" was changed to "filii" because the letter is a vowel. A stray ink mark at the foot of the page is not text and was left out.
